From 1997 to 2011 he was the Architecture Critic for "The New Yorker" where he wrote the magazine's celebrated "Sky Line" column.  He also holds the Joseph Urban Chair in Design and Architecture at The New School in New York City.  He was formerly Dean of the Parsons School of Design, a division of The New School.
